title: Host-native assignment lifecycle

non_goals: Do not add provider-specific launchers, parallel stores, dirty-worktree heuristics, or worker proof authority.

effects: Host-native dispatch may pause at a typed host-execution contract without a process command.

next_action: Complete fresh-context review, commit the proved slice, and open its stacked PR on #2948.

claims: Commandless host-native dispatch returns a canonical assignment- and packet-bound execution contract.

Generated Python/TypeScript conformance and static package proof pass.

goal: Make commandless host-native assignment dispatch constructible and integrate explicitly declared shared-worktree returns exactly once through the canonical assignment lifecycle.
